Matte charcoal gray, top face medium dark gray, side faces slightly darker, very subtle short contact shadow. Quiet low contrast, no bright white faces, no outlines, no glow, no colored accents. Minimal flat shaded polygon surfaces, no grain or photoreal texture, simple readable silhouette at 12 pixels. Object fills 75 percent of square canvas. No floor, no text, no other objects.
